about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport TDV8 has been a part of the range since 2005, offering a powerful and refined V8 diesel option across two generations. Early models (L320, 2005–2013) were fitted with the TDV8, while the later L494 generation (2013–2022) received the more powerful SDV8. While both are 4.4-litre V8 diesel units, the SDV8 represents a later evolution with different output and tuning.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace TDV8 or SDV8 engines for every Range Rover Sport TDV8 on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 ENGINE

cards.body: A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2005 to 2013. This engine is known for a well-documented pattern of timing chain wear and injector seal leaks. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild.
cards.cta: Check Your TDV8 Range Rover Sport TDV8

cards.body: A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2013 to 2022. A later iteration of the V8 diesel, it shares the same pattern of timing chain wear and injector seal leaks as its predecessor. We service it to the same standard as the TDV8.

compatibility.intro: Because the Range Rover Sport TDV8 spans two similar but distinct engines across two generations, it's crucial to confirm your exact engine code before starting any work. We verify: - Your exact engine code (TDV8 or SDV8) via registration or VIN - Your generation (L320 or L494) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification
